question: What is the meaning of buildings list in relation to physical composition?
description: The buildings list refers to a structured representation of the physical composition of buildings, including their components, such as site, building, storey, space, element, product, material, and raw material. This list is organized using a hierarchical structure, with each component connected to the next through relationships defined by the Building Topology Ontology (BOT). The list provides a comprehensive overview of the physical composition of buildings, enabling stakeholders to better understand and manage their construction and maintenance.
